checks: Deriver (hand) and checker (machine, bmhvkit) agree coefficient by coefficient: per graph N_0 and P N_1 for a, b, c1, c2, all 10 pairs (f, r), and in total.

Referee re-derivation by hand: prefactors (-i, +i, +1, +1), the Dirac reductions of a, b, c1, the integrals khat^2 D^3 -> -eta/2, khat^2 kbar 2k.P D^4 -> -eta/6 Pbar, the group factors of c1/c2 and nu_(fr) for all pairs; agree.
Checker scripts re-run by the referee: check_crosscheck.py (explicit matrices d=6,8, hand eta/eps vs engine, routing) and check_st_pole.py (pole-level ST identity for all 10 pairs) pass.

Pole-level ST identity: K T(Delta graphs) + V_{b_d delta S^(1)} = 0; evanescent part via z_R = -(C_ad/2)/(16 pi^2 eps) of Q_R (agrees with g0_ghost_sources final_result); 4-dim N_F part: -(C_f+Y_f) [Q_K, g0_FF] + (C_f+C_ad+Y_f) [Q_V, g0_FFV] - C_ad/2 [Q_R] - C_ad/2 [Q_rho partial] = 0 (agrees with the final results of g0_FF, g0_FFV, g0_ghost_sources).
Rigid invariance: P X = 0 at q = 0 (c1 and c2 separately not, their sum is); N_E components of c1, c2 (+-i C_ad/12) cancel.
No dependence on M or m^2; Evan N_1 = 0.
Completeness: diagram list agrees with ENUMERATION.md (g1_cFF, 10 assignments, 42 multiplet-level graphs) and with the class specification.

Literature (targets_in_our_conventions.md, sec. 2.2, and VALIDATION.md (iii)): pole = (1/2) Delta_1|_{omega -> omega_C}; X ⊃ -l sum_f int omega^a dbar_mu[Psibar gbar^mu((C_f - C_ad/4) T^a + Sigma^a/2) P_c Psi] = -l sum lambda N_F, Sigma^a = M^a: identical.
caveats: The pole is proportional to Delta_1^((f r)) (d-dimensional, with external sterile components); this ghost-number-1 evanescent monomial is not among the operators of 03b (whose evanescent list is ghost-number-0 and whose N basis is four-dimensional). It is the evanescent part of b_d Q_R^(fr).
Vertex functions follow the 03b convention (coefficient of theta_omega theta_Psibar theta_Psi, ghost first); Feynman rule = i x vertex function.

The 4-dim cancellation of the Yukawa part of the N_F pole uses cal(Y)_f of g0_FF/g0_FFV; it was verified with independently computed delta S^(1) graphs by the checker and against those classes' final results by the referee.
Per-pair entries in 'functions' (after the generic one) are the checker's machine output, in the basis slb(p), slb(p)' with V[N_F] = i (slb(p)' - slb(p)) Tg^a P_c.
